note: Industry baseline benchmarks for pharma omnichannel engagement (researched 2026-07). Two agents consume this: Maya (Market & Competitive Intelligence) sizes the audience and reads its access/digital posture; Arjun (Activation Planning) sets channel engagement targets and KPI baselines. Every figure carries a `confidence` tag: 'cited' = taken from a named public source listed in `sources`; 'approximate' = a well-established directional industry figure not tied to one source in this capture (validate before external use); 'derived' = computed by us from cited inputs. Rates are directional industry baselines, NOT brand-specific forecasts: a brand's own historical data always supersedes these.

email_hcp_broadcast.label: HCP email: broadcast/newsletter
email_hcp_broadcast.note: Traditional (non-triggered) pharma HCP email opens sit near 5%; the pharma brand-email CTR benchmark is ~2.25%. Far below the general healthcare email vertical. Do not benchmark pharma HCP broadcast against generic healthcare email.

email_hcp_triggered.label: HCP email: triggered / behaviour-based
email_hcp_triggered.note: Triggered campaigns materially outperform broadcast (18.26% open vs ~5%). The single highest-leverage email change is moving from broadcast to behaviour-triggered.

email_healthcare_vertical.label: Healthcare vertical email (context only)
email_healthcare_vertical.note: Medical/dental/healthcare marketing email benchmark. CONTEXT ONLY: a much broader audience than HCP-targeted pharma promotion; using it as a pharma HCP target sets an unreachable bar.

email_hcp_targeted_range.label: HCP-targeted pharma email: CTR working range
email_hcp_targeted_range.note: Typical working CTR band for well-targeted HCP pharma email.

webinar_hcp.label: HCP webinar / webcast
webinar_hcp.note: Pharma leads all industries on webinar attendance (~50% of registrants attend). 55% of HCP attendees prefer on-demand over live. Always fund the replay.

programmatic_display_hcp.label: Programmatic display (HCP endemic/non-endemic)
programmatic_display_hcp.note: Healthcare Services programmatic display ~0.25% CTR; the broader Healthcare & Pharma display vertical averages ~0.59%. Google Display overall is ~0.10%. Mobile outperforms desktop by 33-68% across creative formats.

video_display.label: Video display
video_display.note: Video display formats achieve ~0.56% CTR despite lower inventory availability.

paid_search_hcp.label: Paid search (HCP-targeted)
paid_search_hcp.note: Search intent converts far above display: HCP-targeted search CTR ~6.88%. Highest-intent, lowest-reach channel.

field_rep_detail.label: Field rep detailing
field_rep_detail.note: See hcp_access block: access is the binding constraint on this channel, not creative quality.

patient_support_program.label: Patient support program
patient_support_program.note: Enrolment and adherence lift are highly program-specific; no defensible cross-industry rate. Treat as a brand-measured channel, not a benchmarked one.

hcp_access.note: Only ~45% of HCPs globally are accessible to biopharma (down from ~60% eighteen months prior); fewer than 35% of US physicians are rep-accessible; ~39% had no rep contact in the last six months. Half of HCPs restrict engagement to three or fewer companies. Access, not message quality, is the first constraint on any Field-heavy plan.

digital_affinity.note: Directional industry findings, not brand-specific. Personalization/relevance is the single biggest engagement lever cited across sources.

hcp_universe_us._note: US practising-physician counts used to size a target audience. 'cited' entries are traceable to the named source; 'approximate' entries are well-established directional figures. Validate against AMA/AAMC/IQVIA before external use.

hematology-oncology.note: Hematologist/oncologists billing Medicare in 2024 (up from 12,267 in 2014).

persona_channel_affinity._note: Affinity index 1 (low) to 5 (high) per channel bucket, per the tool's persona vocabulary (strategy/rules.py). Derived from PERSONA_MULTIPLIERS and the behaviour-based segment research in config/audience_segments.json.

lifecycle_kpi_targets._note: Target bands applied to the channel baselines above. 'index' multiplies the baseline; the resulting band is what 'good' looks like for that lifecycle stage. Derived, directional. Replace with the brand's own historical performance as soon as one in-market period exists.

growth.emphasis: Depth of engagement and share-of-voice conversion

loe.emphasis: Retention of the adherent base; minimal acquisition spend

dtc_patient.specialty_launch_dtc_effect: Specialty launches (2013-2023) investing >= $1M in DTC saw nearly 2x the patients per treating provider in Year 1 versus launches with minimal DTC.
dtc_patient.note: DTC ROI is declining as costs rise; frequency and creative quality increasingly determine cost per engaged patient.

governance.frequency_capping: Coordinate frequency ACROSS channels, not within them: an HCP hit on Doximity, Medscape, Epocrates and email in one day has been contacted four times, not once. Unified frequency management prevents saturation and fatigue.
governance.trigger_followup: Layer email onto HCPs who engaged elsewhere: a follow-up within ~48 hours of another-channel engagement is the highest-yield trigger.
governance.measurement_shift: Open rate and CTR remain diagnostic, not success criteria; 2025+ practice ties engagement to prescribing behaviour and adherence outcomes.
